svg.text: Operator reports: right-side resistance first, left-side resistance later. Exact contact times were not logged.
Encoder evidence only: relative screw motion stays close; physical tilt was not measured.
Markers = logged samples (~1 Hz); straight lines connect samples.
A | Earlier ascent - right-side resistance reported
Each side uses its own starting position; overlap shows matched travel.
Example t=6.0s: left +0.151, right +0.396 N m
3. Logged relative displacement difference: left - right (rad)
B | Later ascent - left-side resistance reported
Each side uses its own starting position; overlap shows matched travel.
Example t=6.0s: left +0.400, right -0.122 N m
3. Logged relative displacement difference: left - right (rad)
Interpretation: asymmetric commands accompany closely matched encoder travel in both ascent excerpts.
Limits: rounded 1 Hz logs may miss peaks; screw lead, initial alignment and transmission slip are not measured.
The figure supports synchronization under the reported disturbance; it does not prove zero physical tilt.
